entities.name: Shattergang Brothers
entities.description: A gang of goblin artificers and black market weapons runners for hire on Ravnica: Rikkig, Gardagig and Dargig.

entities.name: Rikkig
entities.description: Goblin artificer, one of the Shattergang Brothers, confronted by Gideon.

entities.name: Gardagig
entities.description: Goblin artificer, one of the Shattergang Brothers, captured by Gideon.

entities.name: Dargig
entities.description: The younger Shattergang brother, an explosives specialist known for running his mouth; killed by Krenko.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: Goblin mob boss who killed Dargig.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker who intervened in the goblin gang war.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where the Shattergang Brothers operate.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Guild that put a price on the Shattergangs' heads and was threatened by them.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: Guild that put a price on the Shattergangs' heads.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Guild that sometimes hired the Shattergangs.

entities.name: Goblin gang war
entities.description: A gang war started by Dargig's death.

events.summary: Krenko kills Dargig when a weapon drop goes bad, starting a goblin gang war.
events.quote: was killed by the goblin mob boss Krenko when a weapon drop went bad

events.summary: The remaining brothers demand the Boros turn Krenko over or face destruction of Boros territory.
events.quote: the remaining Shattergang Brothers issued an ultimatum to the Boros

events.summary: Gideon intervenes and captures Gardagig, who reveals the Shattergang hideout.
events.quote: He managed to capture Gardagig, who gave up the location of the Shattergang hideout.

events.summary: Gideon confronts and defeats Rikkig at the hideout, but the last brother flees while Gideon saves prisoners from a fire.
events.quote: Gideon managed to put Rikkig out of the fight

relations.quote: was killed by the goblin mob boss Krenko

relations.note: Boros put a price on their heads
relations.quote: The Boros and Azorius both put prices on their heads
Rikkig , Gardagig and Dargig , known collectively as the Shattergang Brothers
